metadata.title: Palo Alto Networks’ earnings show AI brings new urgency to cybersecurity, but stock still dips - MarketWatch

content.text:
Earnings Results
Palo Alto Networks’ earnings show AI brings new urgency to cybersecurity, but stock still dips
Software company posts earnings beat, raises revenue outlook
Palo Alto Networks says customers are showing heightened interest in cybersecurity offerings because of the complexities brought on by artificial intelligence — and that seems to be giving a lift to the company’s financials.
However, the company’s stock PANW fell 3% in extended trading Tuesday after Palo Alto Networks beat expectations with its latest results and offered rosy guidance.
